signature_basis: Read-only independent CLI counterexamples and positive restoration controls; eight current object hashes equal the independently locked versions.
accepted_scope: Subskill mapping schema, identity, entry, path, content hash and original byte-size validation; production and verify share the validator.
Structured refusals for the tested source-overlap, symlink, filesystem-root and missing-explicit-root cases, without mutation or traceback.
Tested read-only unexpected-error paths return failure without exposing exception values.
Same-parent concurrent imports preserve both readable references; tested rollback preserves earlier transactions; natural Windows rename failure does not fall back to copy-delete.
Repo/deployment byte equivalence and pointer reachability are reported separately from runtime loading and effective activation.
limits: No general approval of every extension-import requirement: tenth-domain integration, tool execution adapters, automatic recovery and Pi runtime loading remain incomplete.
Cross-volume availability and non-Windows behavior are not verified.
Existing non-directory deployment roots are reported as parent_not_deployed with hashes_equal=null; verify_scope wording is broader than the observed deployment availability.
Inner transaction exceptions still expose bounded exception text; uniform output credential protection remains a separate open requirement.
EXTEND.md does not yet describe every authoritative mapping field.
Read-only audit disclosed concurrent third-party bytecode-cache changes; eight source/criteria objects and deployed user skill content remained unchanged.
